name: EPIC 212525641
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 15.9 solar radii and 0.79 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 5,328 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.79 solar masses and 15.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,692 K at its surface.
